description: This script manages the review lifecycle for components based on YAML metadata files. It provides commands to start and stop review cycles, clear dates, and display help information. It interacts with file paths, YAML metadata, and utilizes shell scripting utilities to modify component metadata for review workflows.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components with metadata.yaml files in the repository

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message and usage instructions for the script

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and validates path to a component's metadata.yaml file

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a future date by adding a specified number of business days

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review-related dates in a metadata.yaml file to a placeholder

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by invoking an external script
